ideas.pitch: Real-time Charm City Circulator and MTA bus occupancy forecasting platform using historical GPS feeds and commuter density models.
ideas.title: CharmCity TransitPulse
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds directly on proven Poisson regression and forecasting methodologies from past winning projects while solving an immediate local pain point for Baltimore residents attending the event.

ideas.pitch: Geo-tagged civic issue reporting and prioritization dashboard for Baltimore city departments using satellite and street-level image validation.
ideas.title: BaltiMend Community Infrastructure Logger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages computer vision verification patterns seen in winning spatial intelligence projects, appealing directly to local civic pride and municipal judges.

ideas.pitch: Personalized nutrition and meal-planning assistant optimized specifically for locally sourced ingredients and regional food deserts in Maryland.
ideas.title: BioRegion Nutrient Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies the successful architecture of past nutrition hackathon winners while narrowing the scope to address local nutritional equity.

ideas.pitch: Multi-agent LLM platform that analyzes campus building utility data to recommend targeted energy-saving interventions.
ideas.title: UMBC Campus Energy Audit Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines multi-agent orchestration frameworks that won previous green tech hackathons with a deployment target relevant to the host university.

ideas.pitch: Autonomous supply chain risk and anomaly detection dashboard tracking vessel traffic and port logistics around the Port of Baltimore.
ideas.title: PortWatch Baltimore
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs high-performance tabular ML and graph risk scoring techniques proven in financial and operational risk-detection hackathon winners.
